programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLASH & FIRE! ROOKIE AND THE FOX
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the treasures brought for valuation are an elegant grape holder made from silver, a cabinet of rare microscope slides and a ruby and diamond brooch.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Roadshow visits the Outer Hebrides. Amongst the items brought to light are some gruesome medical instruments and a table made from shipwreck salvage.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the Antiques Roadshow team are presented with an Art Deco cigarette case, a 'shock therapy machine', and an ornate pedestal that had been abandoned in a garage.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel marks the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Trafalgar. Among the finds are ornately decorated ostrich eggs and a box made out of debris taken from the vessel.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head to Abergavenny in Wales where a strange coincidence unites two Beatles collectors. Amongst the other items brought to light are exquisitley carved whalebone and a macabre pottery model.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the items viewed are a collection of pre-historic spear heads, an early American flag, a highly valuable silver tankard and a pair of spectacles worn by Napoleon.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visit Dartington Hall near Totnes in Devon to unearth more treasure. They examine a set of royal cufflinks, a letter from Admiral Nelson and a valuable collection of silver.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A return visit to Dartington finds Michael Aspel and the team with another busy day of finds. Objects under scrutiny include a French cabinet with royal connections.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Ever wondered what happens when the Antiques Roadshow rolls out of town? In this special edition, Michael Aspel traces what has happened to some of the star items from the show.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team are at Lichfield Cathedral in the Midlands. Amongst the items are a small statue thought to be from the tomb of Tutankhamun, an early Punch and Judy set and a sword pistol.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Wales where Michael Aspel and team unearth more intriguing finds including a bust of Dylan Thomas, an intricate book of early silhouettes, and a plate.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The experts return to Edinburgh. Amongst the items are an early Mickey Mouse mascot, a rare deco figurine and documents that once belonged to the bodyguard to Edward and Mrs. Simpson.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The experts converge on Normanby Hall where treasures include a marble bust and a pair of rare candlesticks won in a newspaper competition.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Inside the Pannier Market the team discover a cache of curiosities including an inmate's uniform from the early days of Dartmoor prison and a valuable plate bought for a song at a boot sale.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel digs up unscreened finds from recent Roadshows. Amongst the objects are a ring once owned by the Romanian Royal family, an elaborate bed and a bizarre collection of coffinalia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head east to Ipswich where they discover a Duke's chamber pot now used to drink champagne and one of the earliest record players.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team step back in time at the Beamish Open Air Museum. Amongst the items are a rare rapier sword allegedly smuggled out of Russia in the props box of the Bolshoi Ballet.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team enter Border country as the Roadshow visits Manderston. Amongst the items are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome Man Trap and Lord Palmer's collection of biscuit tins.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the objects under scrutiny in Rochdale's magnificent town hall are a gold pencil gifted by King George IV, paint brushes used by LS Lowry and the diaries of a British hangman.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits the Royal Hospital in Chelsea. Amongst the items are a Roulette table built to outwit cheats, a collection of buttons worn by Charles Dickens and a gilded bee from a royal throne.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team are at the seaside resort of Ventnor. Under scrutiny is a family portrait showing a Speaker of the House of Commons as a young boy and 75 Austin vehicles.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel introduces a selection of unscreened finds. Items include an Edward VIII Coronation souvenir that was hastily converted to an abdication mug and early fan mail for Elton John.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Roadshow team head for Lancaster. Amongst the items uncovered in the Town Hall are a valuable pair of clogs, a moving series of letters from Crimea, an anti-slavery ring and a rare tapestry.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: At Coughton Court in Warwickshire, the team finds original designs from one of Britain's leading graphic artists, a bizarre Japanese depiction of skeletons dancing and a lost masterpiece.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Back at Coughton Court, the experts get excited about an Agatha Christie letter, a medal awarded to those who came to the aid of the Titanic survivors and a rare figure of the Queen on horseback.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits Sydney, Australia. Under scrutiny are pieces of furniture made by convicts, a part of the keel of Captain Cook's ship, and one collector receives one of the show's biggest valuations.

Pecos Martinez to be exact, and he's returned to his hometown of Houston to settle up with Clain, the leader of a gang of cut-throats. Clain is busy looking for the money from a recent robbery that's been stolen from him. Soon the stolen cash in Pecos' vengeance entwine and all hell breaks loose. Behind the scenes a Bible touting Undertaker (Umberto Raho), a cowardly saloon owner, & a helpful saloon girl become part of the story. This film made Woods as internationally known as Pecos in the third world countries as Franco Nero was known for Django. programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.sub-title: North Carolina vs. Florida Atlantic Semifinals
programme.desc: The road to the title runs through this electrifying 2023 Semifinal matchup between the University of North Carolina and Florida Atlantic University. Watch as elite athletes like Ryan and Mark put their technical skills on full display, battling through intense rallies and precision kitchen play where every inch matters. The competition moves at a racing pace, featuring high-velocity volleys and strategic momentum shifts that force both teams to use critical timeouts to survive. Showcasing a freestyle blend of power and finesse, the Tar Heels and Owls deliver a masterclass in collegiate pickleball that keeps the crowd on the edge of their seats until the very last point.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.sub-title: AFPL Stop 4 Championship Court - Game 5 - Sarasota Manatees vs. Lakeland Palms
programme.desc: This episode of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, features a redemption match between the Sarasota Manatees and the Lakeland Palms. Both teams are coming off a loss and are looking for a win in this intense doubles matchup. The Manatees jump out to an early lead, but the Palms, with strong play from players like Ava and Ashley Griffith, manage to crawl back into the game and make it a nail-biting finish. The episode features courtside commentary from Jay Carroll and Hugh Greene.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Chennai vs. Mumbai - Day 3 Tie 2
programme.desc: Witness an intense showdown in Day 3, Tie 2 of the World Pickleball League Season 2 as the Chennai Super Champs face off against the home favorites, Mumbai Pickle Power, at the Jio World Garden. This episode features a mix of elite athleticism and star-studded entertainment, starting with a special appearance by legendary Bollywood choreographer Bosco Martis, who discusses the rhythmic similarities between dance and pickleball.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Scottsdale Scorchers are up against the Tempe Tornadoes!

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.sub-title: US Open 2023 – Men’s Pro Singles Gold Medal – Hunter Johnson vs Yates Johnson
programme.desc: Experience the thrilling showdown at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships as twin brothers Hunter Johnson and Yates Johnson face off for the very first time in the men's pro singles gold medal match. Both top seeds with years of experience playing doubles together, these brothers bring a unique dynamic filled with expert strategy, rapid exchanges, and emotional rivalry. From early leads and tactical shot-making to late-game drama and camaraderie, watch Hunter and Yates battle it out point by point in a historic and captivating final. Featuring expert commentary and insights into their playing styles, this match is a must-watch for pickleball fans everywhere.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.sub-title: US Open 2023 – Wheelchair Hybrid Doubles 5.0 Gold Match – Krizmanich & Lipp vs Huletsky & Sylvestre
programme.desc: Don’t miss this inspiring wheelchair hybrid doubles match from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships. Adaptive athletes Rob Krizmanich, Michael Lipp, Patick Huletsky, and Jeff Sylvestre bring talent, teamwork, and tenacity to the court in a showcase of the sport’s inclusive future.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Split Pro Age - Whitewell/Kawka vs. Schull/Endara
programme.desc: Experience the excitement of the Mixed Split Pro Age pickleball match on Championship Court. This video features a unique pairing of new partners Schull and Endara, who are familiar with the heat and come from a grinding three-game win in their last match. They face off against the formidable Lee Whitwell and Kafka. With Lee Whitwell's impressive hands and athleticism, and Kafka's hard-hitting forehand and topspin drives, this is a matchup you won't want to miss. Get ready for incredible rallies and a display of top-tier pickleball as these pros battle it out.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.sub-title: Semifinal - Florida Atlantic University vs. Utah Valley University
programme.desc: The "Superpower" FAU Owls look to cement their dominance as they face off against a formidable Utah Valley squad in National Semifinal Number Two. With elite pro-pedigree players on both sides and a spot in the National Championship on the line, witness the tactical precision and high-intensity hand battles that define collegiate pickleball's biggest stage. Experience every commanding lead and resilient comeback attempt as these two giants clash for the right to play for the title.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Fuzesi/Maalouf
programme.desc: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2025 - Pune vs. Chennai - Day 6 Tie 1
programme.desc: It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.sub-title: AFPL Stop 4 Championship Court - Game 7 - GNV Chomp vs. Fort Myers Flamingos
programme.desc: In the finals of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, the Fort Myers Flamingos and the GMV Chomp go head-to-head. The commentators, including Angel, highlight the youth and fire of Fort Myers player Jade and the consistent dominance of the number one women's team, the GMV Chomp. The match is a best-of-three, rally-scoring format with games to 21. The episode showcases impressive plays from Stevie and Kelsey, and praises Heather Nobler's "nasty" two-handed backhand. The commentators also discuss the challenge for the team coming out of pool number two, which has less rest time before the finals.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.sub-title: NCPA 2026 - University of Mary Hardin-Baylor vs. Penn State
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying intensity of the NCPA Nationals as the UMHB Crusaders and Penn State Nittany Lions clash in a high-stakes collegiate showdown. The Racing speed of "rapid-fire volleys" and aggressive "poaching" strategies define the early mixed doubles, keeping the pressure at a boiling point. Technical Skills are pushed to the limit as players navigate "tight quarters" and execute precision dinks to exploit every inch of the court. Amidst the Freestyle creativity of the "sudden death" format, witness how communication and "determination" shift the momentum in a battle for national pride.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Women's Sr. Pro Doubles - Courter/Carter vs. Dawson/Williams
programme.desc: This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. A key dynamic of this match is that Courter and Carter had the advantage of playing under the shaded court conditions just before, while Dawson and Williams were coming from outside. Jen Dawson is noted as being a seasoned player on this court, having a triple crown in the Senior Pro divisions.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jésica sufre de anorgasmia y buscó ayuda en Cornelio, que ofrece servicios cuestionables de meditación orgásmica. Ángel y Patricia se separaron y ambos reclaman ser dueños de una coreografía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana pone la casa a nombre de su hijo para que demuestre solvencia económica, ahora él quiere desalojarla y ella lo demanda. Jorge exige que su pareja lo deje ser el padre adoptivo de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Voto de pobreza; Enganchado al streaming
programme.desc: Pascual quiere la custodia de su hermana, no acepta que su padrastro administre el dinero, mientras ella hace un voto de pobreza. Bayron exige que Melody deje su adicción a las series de TV.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Los no nacidos; Mi abuelo el influencer
programme.desc: Sol quiere abrir un cementerio para bebés no nacidos, pero su esposo se niega. Un "influencer" hace un acuerdo con una funeraria para darle promoción; descubren que sus seguidores eran falsos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana es psicóloga y demanda a la paciente que le hizo perder su licencia profesional. María pide la custodia de su hijo y 20 mil dólares, porque su exesposo lo afecta con ideas de terraplanismo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Muerte digna; Mujer de dos caras
programme.desc: Roberto quiere suicidarse porque está enfermo, por eso planea dejar a su nieta con un amigo. Por otro lado, Jorge anhela divorciarse, alega que su esposa lo engañó ocultando lo fea que es.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Devuélveme mi pene; Millonario part time
programme.desc: Pía culpa a su sicóloga, también transgénero, de haberla manipulado para cambiarse de sexo. Anselmo se hace pasar por millonario para enamorar a Claudia, quien es rica, por eso lo despiden.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Álvaro y su familia viven una tragedia migratoria, la esposa tiene orden de deportación y él quiere hacer algo. Por otro lado, Alex encuentra una momia, le toma fotos y las usa para publicidad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Pintando con los ojos; La soprano asesina
programme.desc: Dice ser el famoso pintor argentino, Leandro Granato, pero es una farsa, su mujer quiere el divorcio. Lucía demanda al organizador del evento donde ella actuó, y fue atacada por un invitado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pide la custodia de sus hijos porque el padre les exige hacer las tareas del hogar, lo que provoca constantes accidentes. Su esposa le induce erecciones usando electricidad en los genitales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mujer zoofílica; Los huasos y la cueca
programme.desc: Su esposo está cansado de hacer el amor como si fuera un perro. Le exigen a su hijo que respete la tradición de la Cueca, baile chileno que enaltece las costumbres y cultura de ese país.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Abraham e Iruan se enfrentan por el contrabando de anguilas. No quiere pagar por la muerte de su empleado porque dice que en ese momento no trabajaba, sino que tenía sexo con su esposo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Viuda por un día; Suicidio fallido
programme.desc: Rosy pide que Abdul le pague lo que le debía a su difunto esposo, él se niega y acusa al fallecido. David, inquilino de Claudia, la demanda porque un balaustre se cayó cuando iba a suicidarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Engaño piadoso; Me pegas, te pego
programme.desc: Maira quiere divorciarse de Manuel porque tienen un hijo con problemas de salud. También, Francis demanda a su esposo por violencia doméstica, pide 50 mil dólares y él la contrademanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Con mi famiia no te metas; Peleando a Firulay
programme.desc: Juan Carlos cree que la salud de su bebé empeoró por un descuido de Gabriela, la niñera. Yuset quiere que Omaida le pague lo que le debe por trabajar en su peluquería canina.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María no sabía que estaba divorciada, ahora espera un hijo sin derecho al patrimonio de su esposo. Una pareja contrata a una prostituta como vientre de alquiler, ella finge el embarazo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Varias familias compran un paquete funerario sin saber que tienen que compartir la misma tumba. Lucía demanda a Antonio para que le pague a las mujeres embarazadas que trajo a EE.UU.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Novia fichera; El cambio de almas
programme.desc: Juanito descubre que Linet, su novia, se prostituía y que lo estafó, por eso la demanda. En otro caso, el día en que el bebé de Jessica muere coincide con el accidente de la hija de Santiago.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Secuestrado por los Zetas; La niña tarotista
programme.desc: Aldo fue raptado por los Zetas cuando migró de Cuba, su secuestrador reaparece. En otro caso, Alejandro quiere alejar a su suegra porque ella introduce a su nieta en el mundo del tarot.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diego y Armando trabajan en el bar de Minerva y la demandan por las condiciones de trabajo. Mariana pide la custodia de su sobrina porque la madre es una drogadicta que inventa enfermedades.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Terapia fetal; Pillada por los pelos
programme.desc: La práctica de una terapia japonesa causa un enfrentamiento entre Stephany y Samy. Gabriela fue a Venezuela a recoger unas pelucas y las de su amiga, María, tenían cocaína.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Crisis de opioides; El cartel de las ex
programme.desc: Yeny pide el divorcio porque su esposo, Héctor, se ha vuelto adicto a los medicamentos. Rodrigo saca a su hija de su país porque fue víctima de un complot de la madre con psicólogos corruptos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Novio peligroso; Jengibre para el amor
programme.desc: Jay pasa dos años en prisión por un accidente que provocó su novia, pero ella lo culpa a él. Además, Yosaida usa jengibre como estimulante sexual con su pareja, pero se enferma gravemente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Estafada, embarazada y engañada; Me robó mi semen
programme.desc: Rosa está embarazada y su amiga, Liliana, vende a escondidas las imágenes del embarazo. Yamilet contrató a un donante de semen, pero su amigo cambia las muestras y ahora exige la paternidad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cámara oculta; El colmo de la justicia
programme.desc: Raúl demanda a Elizabeth, quien lo contrató para hacer un video social y fue agredido. Juan Carlos se encontró con el asesino de su hijo, quien fue absuelto del crimen, y le dio una paliza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vendió a su hija; Romeo chamuscado
programme.desc: Yosdel pide la custodia de su hija porque Dayana, la madre de la niña, la vendió clandestinamente. Ángeles no puede tener hijos y para que canalice ese sentimiento su esposo le regala un perro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sin intención de nada; La sapa
programme.desc: Por hacer payasadas en internet obtiene más ingresos que como profesor, su esposa no entiende. La suspendieron por copiarse en un examen y en venganza le roba una foto íntima a quien la delató.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El perro se ha convertido en un peligro porque es muy agresivo y lo usan en peleas callejeras. Tiene una diarrea incontrolable, provocada por las galletas para degustación de una cafetería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El autista destacado; Fuga con consecuencia
programme.desc: La acusan de convertir a su hijo en un señor mayor que viste de traje y corbata, y habla como adulto. Hacen un intercambio profesional, pero a él lo retienen en Cuba cuando ella huye a EE.UU.

programme.title: Almas en pena
programme.sub-title: La Tunda, la hija del diablo
programme.desc: Una mujer monstruo que atrae a las personas hacia el monte. El "entunde" es el embrujo o hechizo con el que mantiene a sus víctimas encantadas. La Tunda ataca a jóvenes inocentes con camarones podridos para dejarlos en un extraño "entundamiento".

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es encarcelado y liberado tras meses por Hortensia, quien ignora que Julio César ordenó matarlo. Celia descubre que tiene una enfermedad terminal y lo oculta, aceptando que Ricardo dé su apellido al bebé. Katiuska quema una carta clave y busca dañar al hijo de Celia con brujería. Marcelo solicita el divorcio a Graciela y Misael prepara una prueba de ADN para Glorita, mientras se revela la verdadera naturaleza de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Misael le pide matrimonio a Manuela tras probar su paternidad, mientras Ovidio hace lo mismo con Celia, quien enferma gravemente. Katiuska realiza un ritual de magia negra contra Celia y se compromete con Ricardo. Alejandro se prepara para cumplir la promesa de matar a Néstor. Hortensia descubre que Celia es la madre del hijo de Benjamín y se opone a que lleve su apellido. Finalmente, Celia, Manuela y Elizabeth juran mantener en secreto la inminente muerte de Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, busca el perdón de su hermana. Mientras tanto, Gustavo inaugura su piano bar, evento al que asiste María del Pilar a escondidas. Manuela y Celia descubren con impacto la fiesta de compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que desata la furia de Celia. En medio de celebraciones con antifaces y romances nacientes entre Margot y Alejandro, la tragedia golpea cuando Carrero apuñala a Benjamín en su celda y Katiuska recurre a la brujería para retener a Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia y Manuela interrumpen el compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que termina en agresiones. Benjamín es herido en la cárcel por orden de Katiuska. Celia decide ocultar su enfermedad terminal a Ricardo, mientras que Elizabeth, al enterarse del nuevo compromiso de su padre, lo rechaza definitivamente. Alejandro revela que Néstor quedará libre, y Misael, ebrio, acosa a Manuela. Finalmente, Celia echa a Ricardo de su casa tras quitarle las llaves.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rene examina a Carmen Rosa y la hospitalizan una semana. Leticia insiste en que Vilma intentó matarla. Consuelo le oculta a Natalia que Erasto la visitó. Marisela y Andreína preparan maletas para Estados Unidos. Chencha llega a la residencia atormentada por su secreto. Erasto compra una quinta a nombre de Natalia mediante Rivera. Eustoquio enfrenta a Erasto amenazándolo de muerte. René revela accidentalmente a Consuelo que Arminda, la tía de Rosa, es la mujer que tenía secuestrada a Natalia. Consuelo grita como loca y cae desmayada al unir los cabos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo se encierra en su cuarto recordando todos los maltratos que dio a Rosa sin saber que era su hija; confiesa a Leticia el descubrimiento. Junior defiende a Rosa de los insultos de Rosalía en la clínica. Alejandro confiesa a Adolfo que Rosa es su hija perdida, horrorizándolo al recordar que espera un hijo de Junior. Chencha confiesa a Blanca la verdad sobre Rosa. Erasto niega a Carmen Rosa toda culpa. Junior se desmaya al levantarse para ir al baño. Adolfo decide llamar a Consuelo para enfrentar la verdad con Rosa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis y Natalia se reconcilian. Adolfo descubre por el médico que Junior sufrió parálisis motora y no podrá viajar. Rosa enfrenta a Consuelo en su casa y la expulsa, negándose a oírla y creéndola obsesionada con Isaías. Alejandro confiesa a Rosalía que Rosa es su hermana; ella jura odiarla siempre. Eustoquio se disfraza de Benedicto para enloquecer a Erasto. Adolfo y Marisela suspenden el viaje al exterior. Consuelo, abatida, llama a Adolfo desde el llanto para contarle que Rosa la odia a muerte y le concede toda la razón.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: Episodio 105 (2026)
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor

programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. programme.title: Para Verte Mejor

A pesar de ello, Cristóbal se convence que debe comprar el apartamento lindero al de su primo Guillermo, y accede a firmar los registros del préstamo bancario y así, consumar la compra, a pesar de que Ana decidió no mudarse al lado del hombre que le quita el sueño por las noches, y al que sólo lo ha visto dos veces en su vida,

programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.sub-title: Football Star Accused: Did He Do It?
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From a grumbling stomach, to a gassy gut to ringing ears, find out which body noises are hazardous, which are harmless and how to mute them.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: When it comes to your health, being honest with your doctor is vital to maintaining your wellbeing. Whether it’s a nagging pain or your family’s medical history, find out all the information you must tell your physician.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors checkup, we go inside the O.R. as a guest who lost 280 pounds gets skin removal surgery! Meet the biggest weight-loss loser of the #DropTheSugar Challenge! Dr. Travis’ skills are put to the test in the Baby Daddy Challenge! Could weekend brunch be causing us to put on weight.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: You won’t believe what happens when the show’s cameras go “Inside The O.R.” as a 51-year-old woman has a large fibroid removed, which left her looking 5 months pregnant! Controversial new study claims smart women should marry down if They want to start a family. E-cigarettes and vaping have been sold as a way for smokers to quit – new research on why it doesn’t work? The Doctors’ Court: woman arrested with five different types of drugs hidden…in her vagina?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It’s The Doctors’ “What The Health” show. Can farting thwart flirting at the gym? Can shellfish cause a deadly skin infection? Once considered barbaric, why is electroshock therapy being used in treatment today? Bizarre skincare treatment reportedly used by Meghan Markle. Health risks with DIY eyebrow microblading. How to increase your strength without increasing your workouts!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Find out why so many women are removing their breast implants. Could breast implant illness be to blame? Are you your own worst enemy? Do you get in your own way? Psychologist Dr. Judy Ho breaks down how to “Stop Self-Sabotage!” Could your favorite Boba drink put you at risk for intestinal blockage? Who says self-care has to be expensive? Find out how to self-care on a budget!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors highlights the other side of addiction: recovery. Witness the powerful life transformation of a man who lost his legs to heroin. Then, can a breakthrough brain treatment for pain and addiction offer hope to so many sufferers? Then, The Doctors investigates drug addicted healthcare workers who put the patients they are treating at risk. Hear a harrowing story of a mother who contracted a deadly disease at the hands of a drug-addicted hospital worker. Plus, find out how you can protect yourself from becoming a victim of a medical mistake at the hands of a drug-addicted provider. And, learn the key to harnessing hope when things feel hopeless.

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: El Coyote Mente Diabolica (1999)
programme.desc: Bulmaro Reyes comandante retirado de la policía, debido a su violento carácter que quiso asesinar al hombre que mato a su familia, se ve obligado a ir en busca de aquel hombre que se ha fugado y que por sanguinario le llaman el coyote. apoyado por su excompañero en la policía, el comandante Ríos inicia una insólita persecución a caballo en busca del asesino.

programme.title: El Aguila Descalza (1966)
programme.desc: Un hombre idealista y soñador, trata de resolver los problemas del pueblo mexicano, principalmente de la clase trabajadora, pero muy a su manera de pensar, logrando resolverlos de tal manera, que además de hacrlo reir, lo hará reflexionar

programme.title: La Formula de Rasputin (2000)
programme.desc: En una vecindad de la gran metrópoli, Don Otilio, boticario de mucha fama, descubre un remedio para los males cardiacos, que aumenta el ritmo del corazón. Rasputín, habitante de la misma vecindad y dedicado a sacar dinero vía limpias y procedimientos esotéricos, busca crear un elixir exótico para ayudar a sus clientes, pero no conduce mas que a reclamos y amenazas de quienes lo compran. Don Otilio accidentalmente ingiere su propio remedio, pero tiene un paro cardiaco y cae fulminado, todos ayudan y Rasputín es presionado para que intervenga y cure a Don Otilio. solo se le ocurre darle el elixir exótico, la combinación de estas dos formulas revive a Don Otilio y se crea el súper elixir que genera una gran noticia a nivel mundial.

programme.title: Día de Gracia El Shaka (2012)
programme.desc: Zona controla el tráfico en su territorio a través de “Radio Buchón”. Atila y “El Potrillo” se encargan de que las órdenes de arriba se cumplan. Chano esta a cargo de entregar la mercancía a Zona y sus asociados.

programme.title: El Destazador (1996)
programme.desc: Everardo, famoso líder obrero de la industria de la carne, es victima de un complot político para asesinarlo. El atentado se efectúa el día señalado y a la hora prevista y sus enemigos creyéndolo muerto disfrutan de sus bienes, pero lo que ellos no saben es que el esta vivo con una identidad diferente y lo apodan “El Destazador”

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger than him that Baby Beel will take a liking to, in order to get this monkey off his back, literally!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]

programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. programme.title: Green Acres
